Subtle refraction and soft contact shadows; convincing photographic 3D material, very fine satin surface texture, no neon. Its front is nearly parallel to the image plane, canonical white >_ readable and precisely proportioned, solid purple #5a0fdb face, gently rounded edges, no alternate symbol. Leave the left half and upper third beautifully quiet and dark for desktop icons. Tonal violet, lavender highlights #945df4, deep ink shadows. Art-directed soft studio lighting, subtle richness and depth. No text, no wordmark, no slogan, no interface, no border, no devices, no excessive glow. Output one landscape image.
